decision_source: Explicit user instruction for phase 1: AGPL-3.0-only; internal unsigned acceptance first.
project_scope: EpoCanva-owned source and build/control scripts; third-party code and word-list data retain their own terms and notices.

license_text.verification: Fetched twice over HTTPS from GNU with HTTP 200; byte comparison and SHA-256 agreed. Verbatim full text, including application guidance. No upstream signature or independent published checksum was asserted.

limits: This records the user's license selection and acceptance profile, not an artifact-specific owner/legal release approval.
No public-distribution, word-list jurisdiction, host-test, installer-test or signature record is created by this decision.
Internal unsigned acceptance omits only the signing requirement; functional, data-integrity, corresponding-source, real-host and installation acceptance remain mandatory.
Release-process restrictions do not add restrictions to recipients' rights under AGPL-3.0-only.
